label: b2-approx-20261124
question: On the B2 production tree, does a stronger routing approximation (tail-skip rank 6 or 5, or a resident-expert route prior of 0.25-1.0 on top of rank 7) make long-context decode at least 4% faster while the 305-task gate stays non-inferior to exact routing (margin 5%) and loop signs do not rise?
decision_owner: the user (2026-11-24 accepted output-changing optimizations that pass the quality gates); adopting a candidate changes the production config env and needs the user's confirmation

facts.binary: engine 0.1.63 of v0.2.17 reads STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR (a number added to the router logits of experts already on the card; DETAILS.md) and STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP (rank; production 7); the prior is off in production
facts.upstream_prior: 0.2.7 set 1.5 by default on NVIDIA cards of 13 GiB or less (RTX 3060: story +15%, code +37% decode); 0.2.8 took it back (#4402: repetition loops and weaker results in long agent sessions, 4.5 vs 5.6 of 10 agent tasks; 2.0 showed copy/code defects); 0.5 on a 3060: KL 0.0126 against a floor of 0.0012
facts.tail_skip_kl_20261120: against exact routing, same placement: rank 9 0.030 (agent 0.092), 8 0.039 (0.115), 7 0.047 (0.136, production), 5 0.074 (0.186); scoring 61.4 / 58.2 / 55.2 / 48.2 s (reports/V0217-TAILSKIP-KL-20261120.md)
facts.rank7_gate: 305 tasks: rank 7 non-inferior to exact routing, harm upper bound 1.62% at margin 5% (reports/V0217-AGENT-GATE-20261120.md)
facts.window_cost: real Pi traffic >= 32K: about 17.4 ms per window, CPU experts about 29% of it; both knobs act on that slice, so their gains share one ceiling (about +40%) and do not add
facts.forbidden: STRATA_ROUTE_RESIDENT and STRATA_STAGE_PIN are never enabled (upgrade_gate.arm_env refuses them)

identity.upgrade_gate: sha256 in ADDENDUM.json (frozen before the first run)

kl.yardstick: quant_quality.py run --gpu-experts auto on the production config, as in V0217-TAILSKIP-KL: expert cache filled from the profile, no adaptation, 5 segments x 999 positions; compared with the stored runs auto-ts0-a (exact routing) and auto-ts7 (B2)

runs.role: identity: must equal the stored auto-ts7 run (KL 0, top-1 1.0), else the stage is INVALID
KL curve only, not timed in stage 2

kl.screen_basis: about twice B2's own KL against exact routing (0.047 / agent 0.136), which the 305-task gate accepted with a 1.62% harm bound; the screen only spares the 2-hour gate for candidates far beyond that, the gate decides quality

workload.requests: one per assistant message k: messages[:k]; 120 in all (A 71, B 49)
workload.body: model, messages, tools = pisim TOOLS, max_tokens 16384, stream false, seed 20261123 + request index (0-based)
workload.history: fixed: recorded messages, never the arm's own replies; replies are measured and discarded
workload.estimate_method: A prompts as recorded; B prompts = A last prompt + A last completion (61806) + B prompt - 506
limits: fixed history makes the engine re-read the recorded reply each step (hundreds to a few thousand tokens), Pi reuses its own
pisim system prompt about 800 tokens and 4 tools; no streaming, no NGINX; one session, no switching

reuse_controls.label: b2-adapt-long-20261123
reuse_controls.use: drift of the fresh controls, recorded only

design: stage 1: one production stop for all KL runs; stage 2: controls bracket the candidates, each run a fresh engine of the production tree and config with production stopped and restored between runs, a candidate whose KL screen did not pass is skipped (replay_run refuses it); stage 3: one 305-task arm at a time

metrics.primary: replay requests with prompt >= 32K: engine decode tok/s (generated / gen_ms)
secondary: ms per window and tokens per window over the same requests
KL all / agent segment against exact routing, quant_quality scoring time
stage 3: pass@2 pairs against ts0, decode tok/s against b2
metrics.loop_signs: finish=length replies and the server notices of a repeated token / repeated thinking (server-stdout.txt)
metrics.contention: mean CPU cores of the docker co-tenants during each replay run, from the production monitor (tools/monitor)

rules.stage1: ts7 identical to the stored auto-ts7, else INVALID; a candidate passes with KL against exact routing <= 0.10 (all) and <= 0.25 (agent segment)
rules.validity: as the long-context replay (all 120 requests ok and aligned, engine args, no guard), plus env_ok: the run config env equals the preregistered env
rules.contention: a run with co-tenant CPU mean >= 1.0 core -> CONTENDED; that run is rerun once (--rerun), the verdict is computed again
rules.aa: AA = |C0a - C0b| / mean of the two (>=32K decode tok/s); bar = max(4%, 2 x AA)
rules.pass: gain = candidate >=32K decode tok/s / control mean - 1 >= bar, AND finish=length and repeat notices each <= max over the controls + 1
rules.stage3_choice: passing candidates by gain; a candidate within 3 points of the fastest with a lower KL (all) goes first; at most two
rules.stage3: upgrade_gate.py probe b2-approx-20261124 --baseline ts0 --env <candidate env>: 305 tasks paired with the stored exact-routing ts0 arm, margin 5% (gate17 PREREG), quality_gate.py; stop at the first NONINFERIORITY_ESTABLISHED
rules.adoption: recommend only with stage 2 PASS and stage 3 NONINFERIORITY_ESTABLISHED; the user decides; change = add the env to /home/hhtele/strata-0.2.17/strata-iq3_xxs.json and restart, rollback = remove it and restart

limits: the KL yardstick pins the expert cache and turns adaptation off; in production the resident set moves, so the prior acts on a different set; KL only screens

the replay has fixed history and the gate is single-turn coding tasks; #4402 is about long agent sessions, which the replay loop signs and the gate cover only in part; after adoption the production monitor reports decode and loop signs of real traffic
both knobs share the CPU-expert slice; combinations (e.g. TS6 + P05) are not tested in this round
budget: production stopped: stage 1 about 15 min; stage 2 at most 6 runs, about 1.5 h, restored between runs; stage 3 about 2 h per arm, at most two arms
